_readme: Structured version of questions.md, for scripts/run_golden_set.py. must_contain groups are OR-within/AND-across: each inner list is a set of acceptable phrasings (any one counts), and all groups must be satisfied. Kept deliberately as substring/keyword checks, not an LLM judge — cheap, deterministic, and reproducible by anyone without another model call.
